mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMP ( EMP_ID, EMP_NAME, EMAIL, DEPT_CODE, JOB_CODE, SALARY, HIRE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{empName}, #{email}, #{deptId}, #{jobCode}, #{salary}, #{hireDate} )
mapper.select:
SELECT EMP_ID AS empId, EMP_NAME AS empName FROM EMP
EMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{name}, '%')
ORDER BY EMP_ID
SELECT EMP_ID AS empId, EMP_NAME AS empName, EMAIL AS email, DEPT_CODE AS deptId, JOB_CODE AS jobCode, SALARY AS salary, HIRE_DATE AS hireDate FROM EMP WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId}
